source: Silent Hill f (2025), Dark Shrine, Corridors
manifestation: The first Dark Shrine boss recorded in the game journal as the entity that resembles Sakuko. Its identity remains uncertain. This is not a portrait of the human schoolfriend.

reviewedSourceUrls.finding: In-game journal reproduced under the named boss.
KONAMI-branded two-angle production sheet; the front is intrinsically damaged.
Full rear figure; a mark or cavity is visible through the robe. The reverse pose does not substitute for the non-graphic hover.
Recorded retail PS5 Pro encounter. 77 native 320×180 storyboard samples, nominal 2-second interval, 151-second video. Samples at 70 s and 126 s show the front-facing hover at game distance.

references.observation: Complete suspended figure in the released-game encounter. The actor, both sandal tips, broad hanging sleeves, head rays, spiked cylinder and curved dark hanging element are visible. A sliver of the playable character is visible at lower left, apart from the entity.

Light at the level of the face during the same suspended phase. The top of the light touches the frame and a small foreground weapon enters from the left, so this frame supplies the emitted light and suspended stance only.

Lower-body detail from the KONAMI-branded production render. Maroon divided hem, worn ivory embroidered fabric, feet in white split-toe socks with thong sandals, and the hanging curved dark element. This is not a head reference.

Sony preview gameplay confirms the light, flared sleeves and raised instrument in the shrine. The bright radial object is separated from the body in this specific preview frame. This crop is corroboration only.

Published PS5 preview, near profile from the side. The front is obscured by the high sleeve and handle in the character’s pose. The upper hand carries the raised spiked cylinder; the gold rays and ring float behind the head. The crop stops before the heroine, who obscures the lower legs in the full shot.

A separate released-game recording corroborates the relative position of a bright ring behind the profile and the silhouette of the head, shoulders and loose sleeve. The player is partly visible at lower left. This sample does not determine the position of either sandal.

limits: The body is depicted from the documented floating, light-emitting encounter phase. Release lighting and a distant capture leave facial anatomy unresolved. The figure retains the costume and proportions seen in the game.

Native samples are storyboard images, not full-resolution video frames. The 70 s source is clipped at the very top. The complete framing comes from 126 s. The ceremonial chain links and fine embroidery are approximate.

The side angle of the luminous halo and the raised sleeve was later corroborated against a separate recording of the released game. Lower legs in that side view are partly masked by Hinako. Position of the paired sandals comes from the frontal hover and the lower costume detail.
outputReview: Crown, sleeves, suspended weighted loop, ceremonial implement and the two sandals are legible. The central upper decorative ray reaches the image boundary. The luminous manifestation, not a clear facial likeness, is being represented. Garment pattern and metal ornament are approximations.
combatSourceReview: PlayStation near-profile view supplies the raised-arm silhouette. A separate retail recording at 160 s confirms that the radial ring is naturally offset behind the head when the entity is seen from the side. The luminous appearance therefore need not be painted as a lamp in place of the face in profile. The two sources show the same robes and head ornament. Independent near-profile pose for a candidate, no attack.
combatOutputReview: Profil gauche suspendu de l’entité ressemblant à Sakuko, dans sa pose documentée, cylindre relevé et manche occultant le visage. Le halo lumineux est décalé vers le dos. L’épaisseur des rayons, la liaison visible du halo et le bas de la robe reconstitué depuis des vues complémentaires restent approximatifs. Image fixe candidate ; identité et âge indéterminés, fidélité non certifiée.
